h: NDC unveils its 2027 campaign council with Obi, Kwankwaso and Dickson among the names
p: The NDC has named its campaign council for the 2027 election, listing Peter Obi, Rabiu Kwankwaso and Seriake Dickson among its members. The party is positioning the council as a broad coalition ahead of the race.
more: The announcement comes a day after the APC flagged off its own campaign.
More council members are expected to be named.
